AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted Sentinel administrator registry entry managed by existing admins.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

grantedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

OperatorPublicInfo.title: OperatorPublicInfo
OperatorPublicInfo.description: Non-PII operator preferences and workspace landing choice stored under operators/{operatorId}/public/info.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator.

displayName.description: Operator display name shown in audit logs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation.

OperatorPrivateProfile.title: OperatorPrivateProfile
OperatorPrivateProfile.description: PII-isolated operator record containing email and login timestamps, readable only by owner or admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent Firebase login.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation.

OperatorSession.title: OperatorSession
OperatorSession.description: Immutable sign-in audit record written when an admin authenticates into Sentinel.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in operator.

portal.description: Portal entered during this authenticated session.

OperatorChatMessage.title: OperatorChatMessage
OperatorChatMessage.description: Persisted multi-turn Sentinel Security Analyst chat message scoped strictly to the authenticated operator.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator owning this chat thread.

role.description: Turn author role in the multi-turn conversation.

model.description: Model identifier or operator label for this turn.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was recorded.

/operators/{operatorId}/public/{docId}.description: Non-PII operator preferences and workspace choice.

/operators/{operatorId}/private/{docId}.description: PII-isolated operator email and login metadata.

/operators/{operatorId}/chat_messages/{m.description: Per-operator persistent multi-turn Gemini Security Analyst conversation turns.
